additional_context: MedicationStatement is active, Pharmacy-owned, and approved in source/fhir.ini. Related same-change-family issues FHIR-5916 and FHIR-5941 are already represented on the combined branch, and later reconciliations FHIR-7405, FHIR-7168, FHIR-39165, and FHIR-41500 refine adjacent common-usage, reporter/source, social-history, and informationSource wording without reversing the FHIR-7167 clarification.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current StructureDefinition and introduction already state MedicationStatement purpose, explain that it produces individual statements usable by List, distinguish it from request/dispense/administration events, and provide informationSource/derivedFrom source context.
